reviews.comment:
Está dentro de las peores estaciones del ACA. Fui varias veces y siempre hay problemas con algo: o los baños están clausurados, o no hay atención en el autoservicio, o no se puede estacionar porque están reparando algo, etc. La última vez "no tenían sistema" y no me hicieron el descuento de socio. Al reclamar, me dijeron que  con el ticket de compra tenía que ir a la Central para que me acreditaran el 5% del cargo, es decir, perder medio día, cruzarme toda la ciudad y hacer el reclamo para que me acreditasen $ 320. Inadmisible. No obstante ello, a la semana fui a la Central de Av. Libertador (pasaba cerca y quería comprobar si efectivamente me acreditaban el importe). Fue en vano, nadie sabía en dónde tenía que reclamar y cuando logré que me atendieran me dijeron que ya estaba vencido el plazo (cosa que nunca me aclararon en la estación de servicio). El mismo, teóricamente, era de 48 hs y fui a las 72 hs. Ridículo y frustrante. Hace más de 30 años que soy socio y fue un destrato absoluto. Es, definitivamente, una falta de respeto.

(Translated by Google)
It's one of the worst ACA stations. I've been there several times, and there's always something wrong: either the restrooms are closed, the drive-thru isn't working, or parking is blocked because of repairs, etc. The last time, their system was down, and they didn't give me the member discount. When I complained, they told me I had to go to the main office with my receipt to get the 5% refund, meaning I'd waste half a day, drive across town, and file a claim just to get $320 back. Unacceptable. Nevertheless, a week later, I went to the main office on Avenida Libertador (I was passing by and wanted to check if they would actually refund me). It was pointless; nobody knew where I was supposed to go, and when I finally got someone to help me, they told me the deadline had already passed (something they never mentioned at the station). The deadline was supposed to be 48 hours, and I went after 72 hours. Ridiculous and frustrating. I've been a member for over 30 years and this was an absolute disgrace. It's definitely disrespectful.
